description:
Quote Runway Enhance Frame Rate (model="enhance-frame-rate") in RUB without upscaling resolution; nothing is charged.

Required video_url must be an owned video (<= 300 s, <= 4096 px per side). Supports 10 target_framerate
values: 23_98, 24, 25, 29_97, 30, 48, 50, 59_94, 60 (default), and 120.

video_url.description: Owned Arckep storage key or URL of a source video (<=300 s, <=4K per side, <=200 MB).
video_url.title: Video Url
